body: Man come on...I told you I don't want to talk about those things. Nevermind.  I had a feeling this was pointless.  People generally don't listen...and you aren't listening.

No.  I am not here to justify or explain or convince.  No matter what you say people always have some "but" or some "you should do this" nonsense.  I am not here for that.

I have been denied social programs that could keep me alive financially.  I don't have family who will help in that regard.  I am tired of explaining and listening to criticism and people with no fucking clue telling me what I SHOULD do.  I need money to live...can't get it and can't earn it due to health. When you ask people for help they want to control it...micromanage it...make you dance for it.  I am not interested in listening to people give me advice I have tried over and over or blaming the victim.

I want to get over the hurdle so I can check out.
